name: Udai Bilas Palace Dining Room
why_it_matters: Principal residence of the Dungarpur royal family, expanded mid-19th century by Maharawal Udai Singh II and now run as a heritage hotel — set on Gaib Sagar Lake. The dining hall and banquet room display hunting trophies and crystal chandeliers; the property's vintage-car museum (Dungarpur Mews) is on-site.
insider_tip: Pre-dinner drinks happen in the converted elephant-and-horse stables — ask for the 'car bar' specifically; it's the property's most-photographed corner and easy to miss.
signature_address: Udai Bilas Palace, Gaib Sagar Lake, Dungarpur, Rajasthan 314001
